mapper.insert: INSERT INTO locations ( chatroom_id, email, latitude, longitude, timestamp, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{chatroomId}, #{email}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{timestamp}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT latest.*, u.nickname AS user_nickname FROM ( SELECT l.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY l.email ORDER BY l.timestamp DESC, l.location_id DESC ) AS rn FROM locations l JOIN chatrooms cr ON cr.chatroom_id = l.chatroom_id JOIN Products p ON p.id = cr.product_id WHERE l.chatroom_id = #{chatroomId} AND l.timestamp >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AND (l.email = cr.request_email OR l.email = p.email) ) latest JOIN Users u ON u.email = latest.email WHERE latest.rn = 1 ORDER BY latest.timestamp DESC, latest.location_id DESC

SELECT l.*, u.nickname as user_nickname FROM locations l JOIN Users u ON l.email = u.email WHERE l.chatroom_id = #{chatroomId} AND l.email = #{email} ORDER BY l.timestamp DESC, l.location_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM locations WHERE timestamp < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR)
